company.name: Zeroe
company.shortDescription: Zeroe turns fragmented enterprise data into Decision Artifacts — frozen, auditable, and safe to act on by humans, AI, or autonomous agents.
company.description:
Zeroe is the decision layer for enterprise.

Enterprises today are drowning in data but starving for decisions they can trust. Critical information sits fragmented across ERP systems, contracts in folders, meeting notes, supplier emails, and external data sources. By the time a decision needs to be made, no human - and no AI - has the full picture. Context is missing. Assumptions go unstated. And decisions get made on incomplete information.

AI makes this worse before it makes it better. When you deploy an agent on top of fragmented data, you get confident outputs built on unreliable foundations. There's no record of what was considered, what version of data was used, or how the conclusion was reached. You can't explain it, repeat it, or defend it.

That's the gap Zeroe fills.

We bring together fragmented data from systems of record, systems of work, and external sources - and structure, validate, and freeze it into Decision Artifacts: the exact evidence considered, the reasoning applied, the domain logic used, and a complete audit trail. Every decision made on Zeroe is explainable, repeatable, and auditable - whether it's made by a human, an AI-assisted process, or an autonomous agent.

We work across supply chain and logistics, energy, sustainability and financial services - the high-stakes environments where a bad decision doesn't just cost time, it costs millions.

Every decision made on Zeroe compounds. The evidence, the logic, and the domain knowledge accumulate - so each decision is faster, more informed, and more defensible than the last.

Enterprise AI becomes usable when decisions can be trusted. Zeroe is how you get there.
